whole_population_readonly_SQL:
SELECT DISTINCT cr.*,res.node_id AS resolutionNode,res.resolutionId,
res.content AS resolutionContent,sp.node_id AS specNode,sp.specNumber,sp.specRelease
FROM WorkItem wi JOIN edge wc ON wc.dst_id=wi.node_id AND wc.rel_type='RELATED_TO'
JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=wc.src_id
JOIN edge rr ON rr.dst_id=cr.node_id AND rr.rel_type='REFERENCES'
JOIN Resolution res ON res.node_id=rr.src_id
JOIN edge cs ON cs.src_id=cr.node_id AND cs.rel_type='MODIFIES'
JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=cs.dst_id
WHERE wi.workItemCode='NR_FeMIMO-Core'
ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber,res.resolutionId,sp.specNumber
